name: Jungle Star Eco Camp Dining (AP Forest Department)
signature_dish: Forest-camp meals — bamboo chicken and local Andhra fare cooked by the tribal community
why_it_matters: Jungle Star Eco Camp sits beside the Valamuru river deep in Maredumilli forest, run by the local Valamuru, Somireddypalem and Valmeekipeta tribal Vana Samrakshana Samithi with the AP Forest Department. Meals are included with the cottages and cooked by the community — the most authentic way to eat bamboo chicken and tribal Andhra food at the source.
insider_tip: Dining is part of the cottage tariff (around ₹4000 for two, food included) — book the stay to eat here. The camp is about 4km off Maredumilli village on the Bhadrachalam road; arrange in advance, there are no walk-in tables.
signature_address: Jungle Star Eco Camp, Valamuru, Maredumilli–Bhadrachalam Road, Maredumilli, East Godavari District, Andhra Pradesh 533295

name: Gowrisri Restaurant
why_it_matters: One of the better-known sit-down restaurants in Maredumilli village, set riverside so you can eat bamboo chicken and biryani with a view of the water. It is the practical choice for a day-tripper who wants a proper table rather than an open-air stall.
insider_tip: Bamboo chicken is cooked to order — ask for it on arrival and it will be ready by the time you have seen a waterfall. The riverside seating is the reason to choose this over the roadside cooks.
signature_address: Gowrisri Restaurant, Maredumilli village, East Godavari District, Andhra Pradesh 533295

name: Anandobrahma Restaurant
why_it_matters: Anandobrahma is a Maredumilli restaurant specifically known for the village's bamboo chicken biryani — biryani cooked inside bamboo, the speciality that put Maredumilli on the food map and that travels far less well than it eats here.
insider_tip: Order the bamboo biryani, not just the bamboo chicken — it is the rarer dish and the kitchen's signature. Cooking takes time; order first, sightsee, then eat.
signature_address: Anandobrahma Restaurant, Maredumilli village, East Godavari District, Andhra Pradesh 533295

name: Maredumilli Roadside Bamboo Chicken Stalls
signature_dish: Bamboo chicken grilled over wood fire at forest-road stalls
why_it_matters: Along the Maredumilli–Rampachodavaram forest road, tribal cooks run open-air stalls grilling bamboo chicken over wood fires — the rawest version of the dish, prepared the way the Konda Reddi and tribal communities of the East Godavari forests have always cooked it.
insider_tip: Pick a stall that is actively roasting fresh bamboo, not reheating. The drive from Rajahmundry takes about two hours, so time arrival so the chicken is ready when you are — it needs 30-45 minutes in the fire.
signature_address: Maredumilli–Rampachodavaram road, Maredumilli, East Godavari District, Andhra Pradesh 533295
